title: Grid Pulse
summary: A pulse-driven grid challenge that tests timing and sequence maintenance.
instructions: Press Space on the pulse beats to keep the grid energized and score a longer run.

overlay.startCopy: Keep the pulse grid energized by hitting beats on time and extending the rhythm run.

help.title: How To Start
steps: Press Start Pulse in the center overlay.
Watch the grid and learn the active cells.
Press Space on the pulse beats to score.
Keep the sequence alive to build a longer chain.
tips: The grid speeds up when you keep the timing clean.
Watch the active cells before you tap.

onboarding.title: Pulse Setup
startSteps: Open Help to see the beat pattern rules.
Press Start Pulse to begin the loop.
Tap Space on the brightest beat cells.
onboarding.firstGoal: Hit the first beat sequence without breaking the chain.
